summary: Easy Order full-stack testing complete. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests pass across health/seed, Products CRUD, Customers CRUD, and Orders (create with items, list, filter by customer_id, get by id, delete, 404 handling). Frontend: All critical mobile flows verified on 390x844 viewport - Order Catalog loads with 3 seeded products, customer picker modal opens with 2 seeded customers, Potvrdi (confirm) button correctly disabled until a customer is selected AND at least one qty>0, discount + qty inputs accept numeric values, ordered-count shows correctly, Potvrdi navigates to /invoice with a valid order id, invoice screen shows Kupac/Datum/Email/all product meta values/Popust/Naruceno komada/Ukupno stavki plus copy-invoice-button and send-email-button (both present and clickable), History tab lists the created order and tapping opens invoice, Admin tab segment control switches products/customers, fab-add opens form modal, form-save-button creates a new item, delete removes it. Language toggle SR<->EN updates labels (Izaberi kupca <-> Select customer). No red screen errors, no page errors. Note: MailComposer/native email compose and expo-image-picker cannot be fully exercised in the web preview (per spec) - buttons/pickers open UI correctly but native functionality is device-only.

issues: Serbian pluralization: shows '1 Stavke' for count=1 - grammatically should be '1 Stavka' (singular). Non-critical i18n polish.
